parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end timestamp of the trajectory, in milliseconds.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If this parameter is unavailable, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

parameters.name: MapMatch
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to correct the location based on the map. Valid values:
- **0**: No. Trajectory correction is not performed.
- **1**: Yes. Trajectory correction is performed.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.
A ProductKey is a globally unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for a new product. You can view the information of all products under the current account in the IoT Platform console or by calling [QueryProductList](~~69271~~).

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start timestamp of the trajectory, in milliseconds.
